'''2023 Online Retro Event''' was the Players Committee Premiere–Special Edition retro event on GEMP, April–June 2023. [[Timo Dusel]] defeated [[Joe Horbey]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-06-annual-online-retro-event-premiere-special-edition-april-june-2023/</ref><ref name="wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/timo-dusel-wins-the-2023-online-retro-event-for-charity/ Timo Dusel Wins the 2023 Online Retro Event for Charity], starwarsccg.org (20 June 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022211617/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/timo-dusel-wins-the-2023-online-retro-event-for-charity.html Internet Archive]</ref> Participants and other donors raised more than $1,200 for the Child Cancer Fund in honor of Shawn Valdez.<ref name="wrap" /><ref name="dc-1120751240150781982">"participants who donated $1,200+ to the Child Cancer Fund in honor of Shawn Valdez", Solidsnack3 in #cantina, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (20 June 2023). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/1120751240150781982 Discord message]</ref> Every Match Play game was streamed live, starting with [[Timo Dusel]] against [[Sean Luhks]] on 2 June 2023.<ref name="wrap" /><ref name="dc-1114204491319881839">"The Retro event kicks off the top 8 today with Timo Dusel v Sean Luhks.", Solidsnack3 in #cantina, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (2 June 2023). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/1114204491319881839 Discord message]</ref>
